description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class. It is used to handle filtering parameters, specifically for employee supervisor search functionality within the HRM system, including setting and getting employee number and managing allowed sort fields.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object that encapsulates filtering parameters for searching employee supervisor records, extending the base FilterParams class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'supervisor.lastName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value, which can be null or a string.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value; accepts a string or null.
